description: R7 Task 2: parametric-bootstrap neutral calibration. 400 alignments simulated under each gene's own production null-model MLE parameters (background omega distribution mean over omega<=1 classes, per-gene kappa from GTR rates, per-gene F3x4 freqs, fitted branch lengths), real gap masks overlaid; BUSTED srv=No; all simulations are null by construction so p<0.05 fraction estimates the empirical FPR and BH rejection count the empirical FDR.
limitations: evolver does not simulate an indel process; observed per-species gap patterns are overlaid deterministically instead of being generated by the model
single-omega approximation of the fitted 3-class background omega distribution (mean over omega<=1 classes)
no synonymous-rate variation across sites (not supported by evolver codon simulation)
comparison_r6_fixed_param: R6 fixed calibration (omega=1,kappa=2,global F3x4): p<0.05=1.8%, p=0.5 mass=45.8%, BH FDR=0/400
